Best value for money The ultimate purpose of sound procurement is to obtain maximum value for money (i.e. high-quality goods and services at reasonable cost). Awarding a contract based on best value for money means that the contract shall be awarded to the “most economically advantageous tender((MEAT)”. Therefore, value may imply more than just price; quality issues also need to be addressed. Best value for money is one of the main principles to be fully considered by the FPA and SGA. 6.
